## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and behavior change.

## Validation

Record commands and actual results. Mark checks not run and explain limitations.

## Security and operation

Describe affected trust boundaries, credential access, compatibility, recovery and rollback. Never include secret values.

- [ ] Correct Gitflow base: feature to develop, release/hotfix following CONTRIBUTING.
- [ ] Human-readable formatting, names, API documentation and security rationale reviewed.
- [ ] Tests and qualification evidence updated without suppressions or unsupported assurance claims.
- [ ] No real credentials or local runtime assets added.
